title: Pan-Seared Fish with Indian Curry Sauce
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish featuring pan-seared fish in a rich Indian-inspired curry sauce. This recipe is perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.

ingredients.name: Fish (6 oz)
ingredients.notes: Any white fish works well, such as cod or tilapia

ingredients.name: Crispy onions
ingredients.notes: Use pre-made crispy onions or make your own

instructions: Season the fish with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and add 1 tsp of oil.
Sear the fish for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the fish to a baking sheet and bake for 5-7 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, heat 1 tsp of oil in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the wine and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced.
Stir in the crispy onions and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve the fish with the Indian curry sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
